transcript: Here is everything I received on my most recent visit to the masquerade, aka immersive Phantom. So if you don't know, at some points during the show, actors may hand you notes or props, and if they do, they're yours to keep. And your mileage may vary here. The first time I did masquerade, I didn't get anything, but the second time that I did it, I got a ton of stuff like this note addressed to Christine. Now there's going to be very minor show spoilers in this video, but this was from the bedroom scene. Phantom gives Christine a gift and this letter is sitting on top. The note is read out loud and then she hands it off to an audience member. And at this performance, that audience member was me. Next is two items that come from the carnival scene. Masquerade actually features a flashback to younger Phantom when he was with a traveling carnival. He is being held under really terrible conditions. It's honestly really tough to watch sometimes. But if you go up to him, give him attention, give him some food, he may give you this note. This is one of the few notes in the show that is not read out loud, so the only way to know what it says is to actually receive it. It is a note from his mother and gives you a little bit more insight into his backstory. They also made me and another person this Bracelet out of string. You may also get a ring instead of a bracelet. But this was a really sweet and heartbreaking interaction. Then I got this letter from the dressing room scene. It has this really cool skull wax seal. And if you read it, it is addressed to the managers of the opera house. So this one was handed to me by Mister Jeremy Stolz himself. Then finally, something that everyone gets is this little Don Juan program card. The front has the logo for the opera, then the back has the cast list with some of the character names. But I really love that they made sure to have something that everyone can get and take away from the experience.
